claim: BJP MP Kirron Kher Said "Rape Is A Part Of Indian Culture And It Can't Be Stopped"
justification: High-confidence evidence from the retrieval-based fact-checker, including a verified, unedited video recording and multiple corroborated news reports, confirms that BJP MP Kirron Kher made a public statement on October 15, 2020, asserting that rape is part of Indian culture and cannot be stopped. These evidence items, with confidence scores of 0.90-0.95, are trustworthy and directly support the claim, while low-confidence or contradicted items are discounted.
